title: Creating a role with the same permissions as an existing role shows a 'similar role' warning
custom_steps:
1. Start creating a new role.
  2. Give it the same permissions as the existing role.
  3. Click Create.
  4. Look at the warning.
custom_expected:
A warning appears that a similar role with identical permissions already exists.

You can still continue with the Create anyway button, or cancel.

Note: the build warns about identical permissions (a soft warning you can override), not about a duplicate role name; a hard duplicate-name block was not seen in the build.
evidence: UI: creating a role with the same permissions as an existing role shows "Similar role already exists" warning with "Create Anyway" (SimilarRoleWarningModal, keyed on identical permissions).
